TRAFFIC ADVISORY
PROJECTS COMMISSIONING IN THE FCT (AIRPORT ROAD)
DAY 4 - MONDAY, 16TH JUNE, 2025

Commissioning of the Greater Abuja Water Supply Network will take place along the Airport Expressway (Umaru Musa Yar'adua Expressway) by the China Chamber of Commerce Building

Therefore, there will be road diversion and a switch of lanes. Traffic will be diverted on the main express carriage way before the Dantata Bridge and service lanes at the following points:

Outbound City Centre
a) Traffic will be restricted and allowed to flow towards National Judicial Institute with a U-turn connecting the usual inbound now as outbound on the main express carriage way. The connecting points will be at the ShopRite U-turn to return to normal flow at about 1200hrs.

b) The service lanes will be completely closed from the interchange to the ShopRite mall at 700hrs, thereafter maintaining only the right turn to exit all access to the road.

Inbound City Centre
Traffic from the main carriage way will be diverted to the service carriageway using the slip road near Salbas Filling Station as inbound to the city.

Security agencies will be on ground to direct as usual and the cooperation of the motoring public is highly solicited.
As expected, the presidential movement protocol will be observed.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
